editor_note: The translation keeps the meaning throughout, so it would not mislead a learner. The optimization-level conditions, the NP-hard caveat, the stochastic SabreSwap note and the description of the scheduling stage all match the English. The problems are small. "Subgraph" is rendered two ways: الرسم الجزئي in [24] and الرسم الفرعي in [26]. The heuristic terms read stiffly: "تمريرة بالاستدلال" in [22] and "استدلالية تسجيل" in [24]. The link title in [14] is reordered so that it says "defaults of transpilation options and configuration", while [71] translates the same title correctly.

examples.source: subgraph isomorphism problem ... a scoring heuristic is run
examples.translation: مسألة تشاكل الرسم الجزئي ... تُشغَّل استدلالية تسجيل
examples.suggested: مسألة تشاكل الرسم الفرعي ... يُشغَّل أسلوب استدلالي لتقييم التخطيطات
examples.why: 'Subgraph' is الرسم الفرعي in [26] but الرسم الجزئي here, so the file is inconsistent. 'استدلالية تسجيل' is a stiff calque of 'scoring heuristic'.

examples.source: and then, a heuristic pass that tries to find the best layout
examples.translation: ثم تمريرة بالاستدلال تحاول العثور على أفضل تخطيط
examples.suggested: ثم تمريرة استدلالية تحاول العثور على أفضل تخطيط
examples.why: 'تمريرة بالاستدلال' is awkward. The adjective form تمريرة استدلالية is the natural rendering.
The reordered title means 'defaults of transpilation options and configuration'. It does not match the target page's title, which [71] renders correctly.

examples.source: To gain some insight, let's look at both the circuit being executed
examples.translation: لنكتسب بعض الفهم، لنلقِ نظرة على الدائرة المُنفَّذة
examples.suggested: ولفهم ذلك بشكل أفضل، لنلقِ نظرة على الدائرة المُنفَّذة
examples.why: Two back-to-back clauses that both start with لـ read as a calque of the English.

editor_note: The translation is faithful and reads naturally. Core terms are correct (density matrices→مصفوفات الكثافة, channels→القنوات, general measurements→القياسات العامة), the register is informal throughout (أدِّ الاختبار, مرحباً بك), and the Credly/data-sharing paragraph keeps all its details.

'Variational' is mostly rendered correctly as التغايري/التغايرية, but in five places it becomes التباديلي/التباديلية ('permutational'). This happens in the course link title [95], the quiz options [251] and [252], and the appendix [256]. A learner reading 'variational parameters' as permutation parameters forms a false belief, and the split also makes the quiz options disagree with the teaching text. In [256], 'hardware-efficient ansätze' becomes 'ansätze الكفاءة الحديثة للعتاد', which adds a 'modern' that the English does not have and garbles a standard term. Smaller slips: [164] 'ما هو ملاحظتك' is ungrammatical (should be 'ما ملاحظتك'), and the heading tag is (كمي) in [83] but (كمومي) in [88].

examples.why: تباديلية means 'permutational', which teaches a false concept. Everywhere else the file correctly uses التغايرية, including [90] for the same course.

examples.source: An ansatz should produce random states using its variational parameters.
examples.translation: يجب أن ينتج الـ ansatz حالات عشوائية باستخدام معاملاته التباديلية.
examples.suggested: يجب أن ينتج الـ ansatz حالات عشوائية باستخدام معاملاته التغايرية.
examples.why: 'Variational parameters' becomes 'permutational parameters' in a graded quiz option, so it no longer matches the term used in [89] and [258]. The same error appears in [252].

examples.source: There is an inherent challenge in selecting the right variational ansatz. ... while hardware-efficient ansätze have shallower circuits ... many ansätze introduce excessive variational parameters
examples.translation: هناك تحدٍّ متأصل في اختيار الـ ansatz التباديلي الصحيح ... في حين أن ansätze الكفاءة الحديثة للعتاد ... معاملاتٍ تباديليةً زائدة
examples.suggested: اختيار الـ ansatz التغايري الصحيح ... في حين أن ansätze الفعّالة عتاديًا (hardware-efficient) ... معاملاتٍ تغايريةً زائدة
examples.why: 'Variational' is rendered as 'permutational' twice. 'Hardware-efficient' also gains a 'modern' that is not in the source and no longer reads as the standard term.
The pronoun's gender does not agree with the feminine noun ملاحظة.
